title: 第559章 烟霞峰包吃包住待遇从优第558章 不想死的话就别打扰我下棋
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
随着陆鸣威胁的话语开口。
六极宫主脸色一瞬间变得极其难看。
他修行这么多年，自登临六极宫主之位以来，整个西漠无人敢对他不敬。
别说是一个凡人，就算是各大宗门的掌门见他也要恭恭敬敬地行礼问候。
可如今，这个青衫年轻人竟然用威胁的口吻同他说话。
几乎是瞬间，一股怒火噌地一下窜上心头，六极宫主的手掌不自觉地握紧成拳，浑身灵气也在经脉中奔腾涌动，仿佛下一秒要破体而出。
他身后的三位长老也感受到了宫主身上的气息波动，纷纷紧张地看着他，随时准备出手。
见得此景，血刀门的众弟子也紧张了起来。
虽然他们承认六极宫是西漠当之无愧的霸主，但在陆鸣面前他们丝毫不怀疑下场是什么。
然而，就在六极宫主那股怒气即将冲破理智的刹那，他看了眼刚才那位长老消失的地方。
一个合体初期的长老，连一招都没能接下，甚至连惨叫都没来得及发出，就那么轻描淡写地消失了。
而他自己，虽然比那位长老高出三个小境界，但扪心自问，他也不可能做到如此干净利落地击杀一位合体修士，更何况从始至终连灵气波动都没有。
于是，六极宫主深吸一口气，强行压下心中的怒火，缓缓松开了握紧的拳头，侧头对几位长老道：
“不要轻举妄动。”
几人闻言也纷纷收起灵器，但依然保持着高度的警惕，目光死死锁定在陆鸣身上，生怕他突然发难。
庭院中，重新陷入了安静。
只有棋子落下的声响，在寂静的空气中回荡。
时间缓缓流逝。
棋盘上，黑白双方的厮杀已经进入了白热化阶段。
黄峰虽然棋艺精湛，但面对陆鸣这一局异常猛烈的攻势，也不得不打起十二分的精神应对。

再加上六极宫主在场，黄峰面对此番场景也有些无措，只想赶紧结束棋局，导致棋艺大幅下降。
而陆鸣则是越下越兴奋，他难得在棋盘上占据如此大的优势，每一步都走得信心十足，甚至偶尔还会哼出几声不成调的小曲。
六极宫主和三位长老就这么站在一旁，看着两人你一子我一子地落子，脸色越来越复杂。
他们千里迢迢从西漠赶到东荒，原本是来兴师问罪的，结果却变成了围观两个人大眼瞪小眼地下棋，而且憋屈的是他们还不敢出声催促。
也不知过了多久，或许半个时辰，或许只有两刻。
终于，随着黄峰落下最后一枚黑子，棋盘上的局势尘埃落定。
陆鸣盯着棋盘看了半晌，然后长长地叹了一口气，将手中的白子往棋篓里一丢：“唉，又输了，就差那么一步啊！”
黄峰连忙拱手道：
“前辈棋艺精进神速，晚辈也只是侥幸取胜。若是前辈中盘时没有贪那一子，稳稳收官，晚辈绝不是对手。”
陆鸣摆了摆手，虽然嘴上说着“输了就是输了”，但脸上却没有太多沮丧的神色，反而带着几分意犹未尽。
前世就喜欢下围棋，没想到都到修仙界了还是喜欢下。
没办法，谁让下棋就是这么有意思呢。
而且黄峰这老登棋艺相当了得，今后得和他多下下棋。
content_en:
Following Lu Ming's threatening words, he spoke.
Palace Master Liuji's face turned extremely ugly in an instant.
He has been practicing for so many years, and since he ascended to the position of the Lord of the Six Extremes Palace, no one in the entire Western Desert dares to disrespect him.
Not to mention a mortal, even the heads of major sects would greet him respectfully.
But now, the young man in green shirt actually spoke to him in a threatening tone.
Almost instantly, a burst of anger rushed into his heart. The Master of the Six Extremes Palace clenched his hands into fists unconsciously, and the spiritual energy all over his body surged through his meridians, as if he was about to burst out of his body in the next second.
The three elders behind him also felt the palace master's aura fluctuations, and they all looked at him nervously, ready to take action at any time.
Seeing this scene, the disciples of the Blood Knife Sect also became nervous.
Although they admitted that Liuji Palace was the well-deserved overlord of the Western Desert, they had no doubt about the outcome in front of Lu Ming.
However, just when the Liuji Palace Master's anger was about to break through his reason, he glanced at the place where the elder disappeared just now.
An elder who was in the early stage of integration could not even take a single move, and even didn't have time to scream, and just disappeared so lightly.
As for himself, although he was three small realms higher than that elder, if he asked himself, he couldn't kill a fused monk so cleanly, not to mention that there was no spiritual energy fluctuation from beginning to end.
Therefore, Palace Master Liuji took a deep breath, suppressed the anger in his heart, slowly loosened his clenched fists, turned his head and said to the elders:
"Don't act rashly."
After hearing this, several people also put away their spiritual weapons, but still maintained a high degree of vigilance, their eyes fixed on Lu Ming, for fear that he would suddenly attack.
In the courtyard, silence fell again.
Only the sound of the chess pieces falling echoed in the silent air.
Time passes slowly.
On the chessboard, the fighting between black and white has entered a fierce stage.
Although Huang Feng has superb chess skills, he still had to brace himself to deal with Lu Ming's extremely fierce offensive in this round.
Coupled with the presence of the Six Extremes Palace Master, Huang Feng was a little at a loss when faced with this scene. He just wanted to end the chess game quickly, resulting in a significant decline in his chess skills.
Lu Ming, on the other hand, became more and more excited as he played. It was rare for him to have such a big advantage on the chessboard. He made every move with confidence, and even occasionally hummed a few tuneless songs.
The Master of Liuji Palace and the three elders just stood aside, looking at the two of them, one by one, and one by one, with increasingly complicated expressions on their faces.
They traveled thousands of miles from the Western Desert to the Eastern Wasteland. They were originally here to raise an army to punish the enemy, but instead they ended up watching two people playing chess with big eyes and small eyes. What was aggrieved was that they did not dare to speak out to urge them.
I don’t know how long it took, maybe half an hour, maybe only two moments.
Finally, as Huang Feng dropped the last black stone, the situation on the chessboard was settled.
Lu Ming stared at the chessboard for a long time, then let out a long sigh and threw the white piece in his hand into the chess basket: "Oh, we lost again, just one step away!"
Huang Feng quickly cupped his hands and said:
"The seniors have improved their chess skills very quickly, and the juniors only won by luck. If the seniors had not greedy for that piece in the middle of the game and ended the game steadily, the juniors would never be their opponents."
Lu Ming waved his hand. Although he said "If you lose, you lose", there was not much frustration on his face, but rather a hint of unfinished content.
I liked playing Go in my previous life, but I didn’t expect that I still like playing Go now that I’m in the world of immortality.
I can't help it, who knows that playing chess is so interesting.
Moreover, Huang Feng, an old chess player, is quite good at chess. I will have to play more chess games with him in the future.
